{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders since they are not actual conversions
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates = conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = conversion_rates.index[0]

# Print the conversion rates for all segments
print("Conversion rates by customer_segment:\n", conversion_rates)

# Return the segment name
highest_conversion_segment"}
